conclusion: The six selected released schema-2 recipes request 15 unique child-tool coordinates not identified by original artifact hashes. No named NFRT target can be enabled under the unchanged frozen dependency posture until that boundary is resolved.

evidence_contract.original_role_inputs: Each target names all 13 selected original role-file SHA256 identities. Those inputs and its exact raw schema-2 artifact rows were inspected; none mentions the required child coordinates.
evidence_contract.parent_observations: The cached parents were independently checked by root against unchanged original ContentHash pins. The linked receipt supplies full BLAKE3, original 20-byte pin equality, byte length, raw source-lock SHA256 and verifier identities. Cached entry SHA256 then binds each parsed config to its verified parent.
evidence_contract.missing_child_hashes: Both complete config.json trees have no property named hash, checksum, sha followed by a digit, or digest. Selected functions carry versions/classpaths and arguments but no byte identity. tools.properties contains only coordinate strings.
evidence_contract.child_observations: All 35 target-coordinate occurrences have existing cached files. Repeated coordinates had identical full-file SHA256 and byte length. These observed identities are proposals only, not accepted artifacts.
evidence_contract.source_reference: The local public NeoFormRuntime reference at commit 2728293a0c43178e2ab775f481a217af1f32b090 was inspected. Its flow is supporting source evidence, not an attestation that every source byte built the pinned artifact.
evidence_contract.binary_api: Public method descriptors and non-final modifiers were read directly from the exact cached NFRT class entries below. This verifies adapter hook shape, not executable acceptance or full bytecode flow.
evidence_contract.indexes: Dependency/artifact indexes remain zero-based indexes into the specified raw source lock. Function and classpath ordering is preserved.
evidence_contract.portable_paths: Repository-relative input paths are public review evidence. Absolute cache paths remain transient and are not inputs to this ledger.

parent_identity_proof.scope: Read-only cached parent-byte verification against unchanged original schema-2 ContentHash pins; not child-pin acceptance or native execution

verifier.known_vectors: empty and abc passed before every invocation
verifier.bounds: absolute regular files, at most 64 MiB; size rechecked after streaming

proposed_minimum_identity_supplement.requested_change: Authorize only the 15 exact observed child identities below for the six named source-route recipes, bound to their original frozen parent requests. No version substitution, POM discovery, dynamic aliases, repository refresh or unrelated child tools.
proposed_minimum_identity_supplement.authorization_is_not_safety_completion: Even approval of these bytes leaves downloader interception, child process networking, ownership rechecks and cache integrity gates open.
